question:
Πάρος (1550-1700)
Research scope: Identify pirate and corsair bases and anchorages on Paros using original sixteenth and seventeenth century sources, exact document/page references, distinctions between permanent bases and temporary anchorages; search Naoussa, Paroikia, Dryos and Trypiti; treat all hits as unverified discovery until original inspection and human scientific review.

findings.source_statement: The consulted source reports that Paros was located opposite Knossos, the political center of the Cretan hegemony, and was surrounded by major Cycladic islands.
